title: Should this Base transaction go out now, or wait?

response.why: Blockspace is 8.4% full at 0.0050 gwei - settlement is at or near the floor.

usage: if decision.submit: send(tx, maxFeePerGas=decision.fee.max_fee_per_gas_gwei, maxPriorityFeePerGas=decision.fee.max_priority_fee_per_gas_gwei) else: sleep(decision.recheck_in_s); retry
